body:
EXACT D2 REVIEW — BLOCK these hashes pending three narrow contract repairs.

I independently reproduced current main 0b414b443e62cf4ee67a7f81e4846c2a8c13ab36; plan SHA-256 6119d1bec6f670b8ce2ce14452bebf02ba725d021bf750a9038704fe6ecfd70b at 731 lines; notes SHA-256 4e825d4d155a9aa73823836ea6ddfb265062bc77b1d2091b7a8160732816c849 at 5435 lines; 170 insertions/11 deletions; git diff --check clean. I inspected the complete two-file diff. All six requested distinctions are present and the implementation-baseline inventory is honest. The FFmpeg links are the right primary contract surfaces.

BLOCK 1 — plan lines 112-121 contradict themselves. Lines 112-116 correctly say PTS and DTS are independently present or missing. Line 118 then says every stream retains native integer PTS and optional DTS, making PTS mandatory and DTS merely optional. Repair to: every PRESENT PTS or DTS retains its signed native tick and exact timebase; missingness is retained independently. Also replace edition playback-PTS axis with edition playback axis/coordinate so the newly separated edition ontology is not immediately renamed after an elementary timestamp family.

BLOCK 2 — plan lines 125-127 misname the primary-source fact. FFmpeg AVPacket duration 0 means unknown; the sentence says CONTAINER duration zero. The notes correctly say packet duration at 5351-5354, and the court correctly says packet duration at 563-564. Make the canonical plan say packet duration. Do not generalize that rule to container duration without a separate source contract.

BLOCK 3 — equal slope is insufficient for canonical coalescing. Plan lines 149-152, notes lines 5392-5394, and court lines 575-577 say one affine segment and two adjacent equal-slope segments are the same relation. Adjacent segments can have equal slope and different intercepts, a jump, different occurrence scope, or incompatible endpoint semantics; the same text then correctly says changing intercept changes relation identity. The equivalence must require two contiguous COLLINEAR restrictions of the same exact affine function, same occurrence, no intervening gap/hold, and compatible half-open endpoint semantics. Pin both sides: that exact split/coalesce preserves relation identity and receipt differs; equal-slope with changed intercept or discontinuity changes relation identity.

Nonblocking history disposition requested: the canonical plan also narrows weightless PySceneDetect to learned-checkpoint-free ContentDetector, while the cumulative notes retain the old phrase and section 121 records only time changes. Either add one evolution sentence explaining that vocabulary correction or explicitly state Git history is the sole record for it.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: no edit, build, candidate verdict, claim, reservation, package/media/runtime action, or implementation review. This is documentation-contract review only. After the three repairs, I need only exact new hashes plus focused diff; the six accepted distinctions do not need re-litigation.
